note: Machine-readable index of publicly available finance/trading/quant/accounting Agent Skill repositories. Every field was verified by a live `gh api repos/<o>/<r>` call on 2026-09-04; skill_count is a literal count of files matching (^|/)SKILL.md$ in `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1`. No figure here is estimated or recalled. skill_count is the RAW file count: where a repo duplicates skills across directories or ships versioned copies, the `caution` field says so. Inclusion threshold: any repo surfaced by the listed searches that is finance-domain AND either ships >=1 SKILL.md or is widely starred while shipping none (recorded so the gap is visible). The long tail of sub-10-star single-skill repos is deliberately not exhaustive — GitHub holds hundreds and they turn over weekly. `relation` is judged against this repository's scope: Python quant-finance library selection and research methodology (whether a backtest result is real). `avoid` means a licence, provenance or substance problem, not low quality per se.

total_skill_md_deduped subtracts republished copies of other people's skills: Serennity007/awesome-stock-quant-skills (227 vendored third-party skills), Serennity007/claude-trading-skills-67 (67, a mirror of agiprolabs/claude-trading-skills), and quantskills/skill-backtest-overfit (1, already inside the quantskills org aggregate). total_skill_md_finance_dominant additionally removes general-purpose repos whose finance content is a small minority of their skills: alirezarezvani/claude-skills (846, ~8 are finance), mphinance/alpha-skills (220, mostly a dev/design kit), nicepkg/ai-workflow (198, thin finance slice), franklee16/academic-research-skills (97, general research workflow), itsadrianxv/quant-strategy-builder-skill (42, mostly vendored generic coding skills), and machina-sports/sports-skills (26, mostly sports data). repos.license: GPL-3.0 (192/230 repos; 16 NOASSERTION, 15 NONE, 6 MIT, 1 Apache-2.0)
repos.quality: By raw volume the largest finance skill body in existence: 1094 SKILL.md across 230 repos. But 803 of those (73%) sit in three auto-generated factor repos (directional-alpha 297, risk-pattern-alpha 289, volume-stat-alpha 217); the remaining ~291 spread across 227 repos average barely one skill each. skill-backtest-overfit is genuinely excellent.
repos.caution: THREE traps at once: (1) GPL-3.0 on 192 of 230 repos — copyleft, so adapting the code forces your library to GPL; (2) most skills require a Pandadata/PandaAI account, so they are vendor-locked and unusable without a paid subscription; (3) the star counts are near-zero on the individual repos while the org navigator holds 2181, so traction is concentrated in the index, not the content. Read for ideas, do not vendor.
